subject: Invoice handoff: lightweight supplier onboarding, PO timing, and email fallback schema
messages:
From: Evan Lee <evan.lee@sierra-supplies.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick question on invoice delivery and PO stamping

Hi Lauren,

We're kicking off onboarding for Redwood and want to align on the simplest invoice path for our operations team. A couple quick things:

- Do you prefer invoices uploaded to a vendor portal or sent to an email inbox?
- If email, is there a required subject line or acknowledgment header we should include so your AP system auto-ingests?
- We sometimes need to include two PO numbers on one invoice (split-billing). Is that supported, and any format guidance?

I've attached one of our typical PDF invoices for reference (SIERRA_invoice_sample.pdf).

Thanks,
Evan Lee
Operations Manager
Sierra Supplies
Attachments: SIERRA_invoice_sample.pdf (application/pdf)
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Lee <evan.lee@sierra-supplies.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on invoice delivery and PO stamping

Hi Evan — great to meet you and thanks for the sample. High level: we prefer portal-first for reliability, but we operate a lightweight email fallback that most suppliers use during onboarding. Below are the practical rules so your ops team can pick the easiest path.

Portal (preferred):
- Upload PDFs via our vendor portal (link shared in onboarding). That triggers an automatic ack and SLA (24–48h).
- Fields we require on the portal: vendor name, Redwood PO, invoice total, tax/VAT line, and an attachment (PDF recommended).

Email fallback (acceptable during ramp):
- Send to invoices@redwood.ai with subject: INVOICE | [VendorShortName] | [InvoiceNumber]
- Include a single-line header in the body: Redwood-PO: [PO1,PO2] (comma-separated if multiple). This header is what our email parser looks for.
- File naming: invoice_[InvoiceNumber]_[VendorShort].pdf — helps our intake SREs when manual triage is needed.

Multi-PO guidance:
- We support multiple PO numbers on one invoice if the invoice clearly maps line items to PO numbers. Prefer format: PO: PO12345 (lines 1-3); PO: PO67890 (lines 4-6) or attach a short mapping CSV.

I'll attach our lightweight CSV template for email ingestion to this thread (redwood_invoice_template_v2.csv) and copied Vanessa, who manages onboarding flows. If it helps, Vanessa can run a one-time ingestion test with your team.

Next steps:
1) Evan — confirm whether you'll use portal or email fallback for the first 30 days.
2) If email, please send a sample using the subject/header convention so Vanessa can validate.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Vendor Ops (payments)
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_invoice_template_v2.csv (text/csv)
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Evan Lee <evan.lee@sierra-supplies.com>
Date: 2028-06-30T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on invoice delivery and PO stamping

Adding a couple operational notes from the onboarding side:

- Portal invitations are usually sent within 2 business days of activation. If Sierra wants immediate ingestion, use the email fallback with the subject and header Lauren specified.
- For multi-PO invoices we prefer the mapping CSV because our PO-match engine consumes a line-item <-> PO mapping for auto-posting. I put an example mapping in the CSV template.
- VAT: include a separate VAT line and the registration number in the invoice body. If the invoice is VAT reversed, add the phrase: VAT reverse-charge applied.

Evan — if you want, we can schedule a 20-min call tomorrow to run an ingestion test (I can simulate the portal and the email fallback).

- Vanessa Ortiz
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Evan Lee <evan.lee@sierra-supplies.com>
Date: 2028-07-01T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on invoice delivery and PO stamping

Looping in procurement rules to be explicit about timing and exceptions:

- We can accept multi-PO invoices, but each PO must be valid and open at time of ingestion. If any PO is closed/expired, the invoice will route to exceptions.
- For split-billing (single invoice with multiple POs), line-item granularity is required. If only totals are provided with multiple POs, AP will need a manual remap and it delays payment.
- Standard payment term is Net 45 unless otherwise agreed in the SOW. If Sierra needs Net 30, please flag now so we can attach it to the vendor profile.
- Escalation path: exceptions -> vendor-onboarding@redwood.ai -> procurement manager.

Karthik Iyer
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Evan Lee <evan.lee@sierra-supplies.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-01T10:13:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on invoice delivery and PO stamping

Thanks everyone — that all sounds good. A couple clarifying items from our billing team after reviewing the CSV template:

- We'll send the first three invoices via email fallback while our portal account is being set up.
- Example mapping: Invoice 2028-221 includes PO12345 for $3,800 (lines 1–2) and PO12346 for $1,200 (line 3). We'll include the in-body header: Redwood-PO: PO12345,PO12346 and attach a small mapping CSV.
- For the subject we'll use: INVOICE | SIERRA | 2028-221
- Any sample ack format we should expect? A machine-parseable ack would be great so we can automate our side.

I'll attach the sample mapping CSV in my next message.

—Evan
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Lee <evan.lee@sierra-supplies.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-02T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on invoice delivery and PO stamping

Perfect — we're good to start with the email fallback for those first three. Operational notes and what you'll receive back from us: 

- Acknowledgement (automated) within 30 minutes: subject line = ACK | [InvoiceNumber] | [Status] and JSON payload delivered to an SFTP/HTTP endpoint or plain text body if you prefer. Example plain-text ack body:

  ACK-ID: RWI-20280702-0001
  Invoice: 2028-221
  Status: Received
  ParserResult: OK
  MatchedPOs: PO12345,PO12346
  Exceptions: none

- If the parser cannot match lines to POs, you will receive ACK with Status: NeedsAttention and the Exceptions field will include the problem (e.g., "PO PO12346 closed" or "line-item mapping missing").
- Please attach the mapping CSV when you send the email (we will only ingest it if the filename contains the invoice number, e.g., mapping_2028-221.csv).

I'll ask Vanessa to run the ingestion test on Wednesday morning and reply to this thread with the test outcome and the portal invite ETA.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth onboarding.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Vendor Ops (payments)
Redwood Inference
